meta.description: Live UK graduate role scanner - source of truth. Rebuilt into dashboard.html by build_dashboard.py.
meta.portal_access_log: 2026-08-27 scan: the-trackr.com app pages JS-blank on plain fetch; gradcracker.com, brightnetwork.co.uk deadline pages, pwc.co.uk, goldmansachs.com, jobs.natwestgroup.com, careers.bbc.co.uk, totaljobs/CWJobs/technojobs returned 403/blank; targetjobs deadline page 404; ratemyplacement redirects to higherin.com. Roles from those sources verified via search-indexed employer content where possible; otherwise marked unconfirmed. 2026-08-27 PM re-run: 10 priority roles re-checked, no status changes; Goldman higher.gs.com shows no 2027 EMEA Engineering req yet; gradcracker + brightnetwork + IBM UK early-careers + spartaglobal careers 403 this run; Netcompany grad dev postings (Leeds/London) expired - watch for reposts; Monzo has no grad engineering roles (piloting early-careers only). 2026-08-31 scan: 12 priority roles re-checked - BAE window opens 'beginning of September' (employer page, roles listed incl. Manchester); Barclays 2027 reqs posting since 28 Aug (tech not yet); Capgemini 2026 req marked filled. brightnetwork/gradcracker/prospects 403 again (search-index fallback used); Netcompany still expired; IBM/Citi/Morgan Stanley/Tesco 2027 UK tech not yet live.
sourcing_rules: Only track roles that recruit into the UK. Leave off if unclear - never guess.
Only record a date from a UK-specific source (employer's own UK page or the actual UK posting). A global page listing UK cities among many is not enough.
date_confidence: 'confirmed' = UK source states it for the 2026/27 cycle; 'indicative' = UK source but rolling/prior-cycle/no year; 'unconfirmed' = no UK-specific source, date fields must be null.
Foreign-market dates are not applicable - do not record them.
Rolling roles with no deadline by design: status Open, deadline null, say so in notes. Never invent a deadline.
JS-rendered portals that return blank on plain fetch mean 'couldn't see it', not 'no roles'. Use a rendered-browser tool or record the portal as unreadable.
Job boards and trackers are discovery only, never the source of a date.
